Built-in SOC 2, HIPAA/HITECH, and GDPR compliance support keep sensitive data protected and every send audit-ready.

Optimize routing for faster delivery

Lob’s routing intelligence, Postal IQ, dynamically selects the most

efficient USPS entry path to get your mail where it’s going faster.

Our nationwide Print Delivery

Network balances output across printers to maintain speed,

consistency, and uptime.

![Metrics Icon](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/5e1e5c62fa3d4447af417098/69126e0cf86dab29eb21b773_metrics-alt.svg)

Track and fine-tune

performance

Track every mailpiece from creation

to delivery with real-time event data

and performance reporting.
